exact_statement: Let G be an infinite connected locally finite undirected quasi-transitive graph with p_c(G)<1. In iid Bernoulli bond percolation on G at parameter p=p_c(G), almost surely every open connected component is finite.
equivalent_vertex_form: For every vertex v, P_{p_c}(|C(v)|=infinity)=0; countability makes this equivalent to almost-sure absence of all infinite clusters.
threshold_definition: p_c(G)=sup{p in [0,1]: almost surely G[p] has no infinite clusters}.
